title: state.go
description: Reads and writes .stego/state.yaml. It saves the record as plain YAML text. It rejects a state file whose input manifest disagrees with the recorded service hash or registry reference.

title: transaction.go
description: Applies output through a journal in .stego/transaction.yaml. It saves the state record last. It refuses a transaction that leaves output untracked. It skips every file the plan marks unchanged.

title: drift.go
description: Compares each generated file on disk with the hash in the state record. It reports a changed or deleted file as drift.

title: reconciler.go
description: Builds the plan and the new state record from the service declaration and the registry. It gives each file one action: generate, update, delete or unchanged.

title: snapshot.go
description: Checks the plan against the world before apply writes. It refuses a plan whose registry digest or compiler build record does not match the live one.

title: stego CLI
description: Holds the stego commands. The drift command fails when a generated file no longer matches its hash. The version command prints the build record.

title: buildidentity runtime.go
description: Reads the compiler build record from the Go build metadata. The version command and the state record both use this one source.

title: qualify-compiler-release.py
description: Qualifies a compiler release at one exact commit. It selects CI runs by head commit. It requires a success conclusion for every named job. With --verify-release it installs the published release through the consumer path and compares every asset digest.

title: install-compiler.py
description: Installs a compiler from a published release. It refuses any platform other than Linux amd64. It checks the size and the SHA-256 digest of every downloaded asset.

title: verify-compiler-artifact.py
description: Authenticates the compiler and its build record before it copies them to the result directory. It requires a signature for both files. It requires the signed record to state Linux amd64 and the selected revision.
